SELECT * from BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE


--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT ACID, EOD_DATE, BANK_ID, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE WHERE islatest = 1 GROUP BY ACID, EOD_DATE, BANK_ID HAVING COUNT(1)>1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ACID, EOD_DATE, BANK_ID ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_WITH_DUP_20230605  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
--8655048
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_WITH_DUP_20230605
--8655048

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_WITH_DUP_20230605 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[ACID]
,[EOD_DATE]
,[TRAN_DATE_BAL]
,[TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
,[VALUE_DATE_BAL]
,[VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
,[END_EOD_DATE]
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,[LCHG_TIME]
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,[RCRE_TIME]
,[TS_CNT]
,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
,[BANK_ID]
,[isActive]
,[isLatest]
,[BNK_CODE]
,[SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_WITH_DUP_20230605; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT ACID, EOD_DATE, BANK_ID, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE WHERE islatest = 1 GROUP BY ACID, EOD_DATE, BANK_ID HAVING COUNT(1)>1

--7

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
--8655048
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_WITH_DUP_20230605
--8655048
